findings.issue_text: Federated rule groups can expose edit, delete, and pause actions because useAllRulerRuleAbilities hard-codes isFederated=false.
Prometheus-only Grafana list items show “Silence notifications,” but clicking it cannot open the drawer because no rulerRule exists.
Grafana-managed recording rules lose the Export action because ModifyExport is limited to alerting rules.

goldens.comment: The rendered GrafanaRuleListItem is missing the required key prop for React list items. This can cause rendering issues when the list order changes.

RuleActionsButtons is invoked with only promRule, but SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer inside RuleActionsButtons still depends on a Grafana Ruler rule being present, so for Grafana rules coming from list views the 'Silence notifications' menu entry (now driven by Grafana Prom abilities) will toggle showSilenceDrawer without ever rendering the drawer. This means clicking 'Silence notifications' for these rules has no visible effect, even when abilities indicate silencing is allowed.

adjudication_records.issue_text: Federated rule groups can expose edit, delete, and pause actions because useAllRulerRuleAbilities hard-codes isFederated=false.

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows in useAllRulerRuleAbilities (lines 238-240) that isFederated is hard-coded to false with a TODO comment: '// TODO: Add support for federated rules // const isFederated = isFederatedRuleGroup(); const isFederated = false;'. This means federated rule groups will not be treated as immutable (immutableRule = isProvisioned || isFederated || isPluginProvided will be false when it should be true for federated rules), allowing edit, delete, and pause actions that should be blocked. The original useAllAlertRuleAbilities function properly called isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group) but this was removed in the refactoring.

adjudication_records.issue_text: Grafana-managed recording rules lose the Export action because ModifyExport is limited to alerting rules.

adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff in useAbilities.ts, the new useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities function sets ModifyExport ability as `[isAlertingRule, exportAllowed]` where `isAlertingRule = prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)`. This means for recording rules, isAlertingRule is false, so ModifyExport becomes [false, exportAllowed], making it unsupported. In contrast, the original useAllRulerRuleAbilities uses `isGrafanaManagedAlertRule` which checks `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rule)` - this returns true for both alerting AND recording rules. So the new implementation incorrectly restricts Export to only alerting rules, breaking it for Grafana-managed recording rules.
